title: RunTimeError when running regression example with GBM model type
author: skunkwerk

comments.author: tgaddair
comments.body:
Thanks for raising this issue and providing and repo script @skunkwerk!

@jeffkinnison can you take a look?

comments.author: skunkwerk
comments.body:
I'm also sometimes getting a different error from the same code, and I'm not sure how it surfaces but it seems to be coming from Ray:

ValueError: The `num_actors` parameter is set to 0. Please always specify the number of distributed actors you want to use.
FIX THIS by passing a `RayParams(num_actors=X)` argument to your call to lightgbm_ray.

comments.author: jeffkinnison
comments.body: @skunkwerk Thanks for following up here! I'm looking into both of these issues, but in the meantime can you see if they repro in nightly? GBMs were heavily updated recently, including moving away from `hummingbird` training, so the original issue may have been fixed already.

comments.author: jeffkinnison
comments.body: I was just able to repro this in master. Looking into a fix now!

comments.author: skunkwerk
comments.body:
I just tried it in the nightly docker image, and was able to reproduce one of the errors:
"RuntimeError: Expected all tensors to be on the same device, but found at least two devices, cuda:0 and cpu!"

thanks

comments.author: jeffkinnison
comments.body: Hi @skunkwerk, I wanted to follow up here because this turned out to be more complex than it initially seemed. I'm working on making GBM pytorch tensor dtypes consistent throughout GPU training, and will keep you updated as that progresses. For the time being, GBMs should train on CPU in 0.6.3 and 0.6.4. Thanks for your patience!

comments.author: skunkwerk
comments.body: thanks Jeff, no worries.  I'll try it out with CPU training for the time being.
